blocks.x: Semis and electronics fabrication run the tightest quality-latency loops in industry: yield analytics, tool matching and cleanroom reliability decided by telemetry at nanometer stakes. The fabs that win industrialize root-cause analytics and predictive tool health end to end. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in yield analytics/excursion rca, defect classification, predictive tool maintenance, with fab dispatch scheduling close behind. Each of these paths produces data faster than decisions, and the gap between the two is where cost and risk accumulate.
the places value leaks, Electronics & Semiconductors edition:

items: Process telemetry, metrology and defect data siloed; excursion root-cause takes days of fab time.
Wafer-defect review by experts; rare classes unlearned.
Vacuums, robots and CMP tools fail unscheduled; tool-down hours compound.
Process recipes are state-grade targets; OT security maturity uneven.
Multi-tier supplier visibility missing; allocation shocks disrupt.
Tool dispatch and lot scheduling combinatorial; incumbent heuristics plateau.
